scientific_question: Can one objective PRE tactical-role degree of freedom improve conditional second/third-place structure while leaving the S0 winner model exactly untouched?

baseline.name: S0_SCORE_ONLY_STANDARD_PL
baseline.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score after stage1 and stage2 removal

candidate.name: S0_OBJECTIVE_STYLE_ROLE_CONDITIONAL_PL_V1
candidate.stage2_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * role_scalar, after stage1 removal
candidate.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * role_scalar, after stage1 and stage2 removal

fit_objective.equivalence_note: Because stage1 is invariant to gamma, optimization is equivalent to minimizing mean L2+L3 on the fit set.

fit_set.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological source order

evaluation_holdout.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological source order

invariance_checks: winner_log_loss exactly equal to untouched S0 within numerical tolerance
winner_brier exactly equal to untouched S0 within numerical tolerance

required_contract_checks: no RESULT or PAYOUT used as feature
frozen gamma not refit on evaluation
advancement_rule.uncertainty_for_wider_replication: 95pct race-cluster bootstrap CI for candidate-minus-S0 ordered_top3_log_loss should have upper bound < 0; otherwise at most PROMISING_NO_ADVANCE_TO_WIDER_REPLICATION

failure_interpretation.gamma_fit_but_eval_fails: NO_ADVANCE; PRESERVE S0 AND REASSESS STRUCTURAL REPRESENTATION BEFORE NEW LINEAGE
